result.reason: The clause reaches the preferred position by providing up to six months of transition assistance at then-current rates, a machine-readable export within 30 days, and subsequent deletion certification. However, it extends the return and deletion obligations to all capitalized “Content,” not merely Customer Data. Depending on the defined term, this could capture HDI-owned or other non-customer materials, exceeding the playbook and potentially changing unrelated rights. The provision is otherwise clear, though placement within the termination-payment subsection is somewhat awkward.
